title: Concept: iframe sandbox combines allow-scripts with allow-same-origin
description: allow-scripts together with allow-same-origin is the documented way to defeat a sandbox: the frame keeps the parent origin and can script it, including removing its own sandbox attribute. Reviewers see two reassuring tokens and the protection is gone, so the pair has to be treated as no sandbox at all.
applicability: Responses that embed an iframe with a sandbox attribute.
risk: Content framed from an untrusted source runs script in the embedding origin, reads the parent DOM and can act with the user's session on that origin.
